lemmas.name: lg29_nil
lemmas.statement: ∀ (nums : List Nat) (k : Nat) (h : longestGoodSubarray_precond nums k), nums = [] → longestGoodSubarray_postcond nums k (0) h
lemmas.proof:
by intro nums k h hx
  unfold longestGoodSubarray_postcond
  exact Or.inl ⟨hx, rfl⟩

children.expr: (let subArrays := List.range (nums.length + 1) |>.flatMap (fun start => List.range (nums.length - start + 1) |>.map (fun len => nums.drop start |>.take len)); let subArrayFreqs := subArrays.map (fun arr => arr.map (fun x => arr.count x)); let validSubArrays := subArrayFreqs.filter (fun arr => arr.all (fun x => x ≤ k)); (validSubArrays.map (·.length)).foldl max 0)

lemmas.name: lg29_ne
lemmas.statement: ∀ (nums : List Nat) (k : Nat) (h : longestGoodSubarray_precond nums k), ¬ nums = [] → longestGoodSubarray_postcond nums k (let subArrays := List.range (nums.length + 1) |>.flatMap (fun start => List.range (nums.length - start + 1) |>.map (fun len => nums.drop start |>.take len)); let subArrayFreqs := subArrays.map (fun arr => arr.map (fun x => arr.count x)); let validSubArrays := subArrayFreqs.filter (fun arr => arr.all (fun x => x ≤ k)); (validSubArrays.map (·.length)).foldl max 0) h
lemmas.proof:
by intro nums k h hx
  unfold longestGoodSubarray_postcond
  intro subArrays subArrayFreqs validSubArrays
  have hnil : [] ∈ validSubArrays := List.mem_filter.mpr ⟨List.mem_map.mpr ⟨(nums.drop 0).take 0, List.mem_flatMap.mpr ⟨0, List.mem_range.mpr (by omega), List.mem_map.mpr ⟨0, List.mem_range.mpr (by omega), rfl⟩⟩, by simp⟩, by simp⟩
  exact Or.inr ⟨hx, Refine.maxlen_spec validSubArrays hnil⟩
